public_message: We accept your proposal of Rs.1250 per tonne for 1200 tonnes with delivery handled by you.
private_reasoning: Seller's price of Rs.1250/t is below our private ceiling of Rs.1300/t and yields total cost (including transport ~Rs.22/t) well under the virgin slag cost of Rs.3200/t. Volume is slightly higher than our target (1100t), but the extra 100t is acceptable given cost advantage. No regulatory issues. Accept to secure supply.
